name: ars-codex
description: ARS-Codex is the Codex-native sibling of Academic Research Skills for deep research, academic writing, manuscript review, protocol-driven study screening, research pipelines, and experiment planning. Based on Academic Research Skills by Cheng-I Wu (CC-BY-NC 4.0).

interface.shortDescription: Codex-native research, writing, review, and experiment workflows.
interface.longDescription: ARS-Codex is the Codex-native sibling of Academic Research Skills. It supports Socratic research scoping, literature and systematic reviews, protocol-driven study screening with blinded reviewers, IMRaD paper planning and drafting, manuscript revision coaching, peer-review simulation, citation and integrity checks, experiment planning, and staged research-to-paper workflows.
defaultPrompt: Plan my academic paper from rough research notes.
Review my manuscript like a journal reviewer.
Build a literature review and identify research gaps.
